title: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.08643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial institutions construct knowledge graphs (KGs) from shared SEC 10-Ks to serve risk analysis, portfolio management, and investment research, whose analytical needs differ. Extraction must adapt without fragmenting shared grounding, typing, and temporal rules. Hand-authored persona prompts and fine-tuning add cost. Weight-free prompt optimization offers an alternative, but unconstrained evolution of a monolithic prompt can rewrite shared rules alongside persona guidance, obscuring changes and complicating review. We introduce FinEvolveKG, a KG-construction harness separating reusable general and persona-policy blocks and mechanically confining GEPA, a reflective prompt optimizer, to the designated block. During persona adaptation, the approved general block remains byte-stable and every optimizer edit is localized to a separately versioned persona policy. A dual objective balances generic temporal-KG quality with persona-relevant

translated_title: FinEvolveKG：面向金融知识图谱构建的可控且可归因的提示词演化
translated_abstract: 金融机构从共享的SEC 10-K文件构建知识图谱（KG），以服务风险分析、投资组合管理和投资研究，而这些应用场景的分析需求各不相同。抽取过程必须能够灵活适应这些差异，同时不破坏共享的实体落地、类型体系与时间规则。手工编写的角色化提示词和模型微调都会增加成本。无需权重的提示词优化提供了一种替代方案，但对单一整体提示词进行无约束演化，可能会在修改角色引导的同时重写共享规则，从而掩盖变更内容并使审查变得复杂。我们提出FinEvolveKG，这是一个知识图谱构建框架，它将可复用的通用模块与角色策略模块分离开来，并将GEPA（一种反思式提示词优化器）机械性地限制在指定模块内进行操作。在角色适配过程中，已批准的通用模块保持字节级稳定，优化器的每一次编辑都被局部化到单独进行版本管理的角色策略模块中。一个双重目标在通用时序知识图谱质量与角色相关性之间取得平衡。
tldr: FinEvolveKG通过将可复用的通用模块与角色策略模块分离，并将反思式提示词优化器GEPA的每次编辑严格限制在单独版本管理的角色策略模块内，实现了金融知识图谱构建中可控、可归因且不破坏共享规则的提示词演化。
en_tdlr: FinEvolveKG enables controlled and attributable prompt evolution for financial knowledge graph construction by separating reusable general blocks from persona-policy blocks and mechanically confining every GEPA optimizer edit to a separately versioned persona block, keeping the approved general block byte-stable.
